description: Before installing an npm or PyPI package: does it exist (AI-suggested names are sometimes made up, and attackers register them), has it been reported as malicious, which known vulnerabilities affect this version (with the fixed version), is it deprecated or yanked, how old is it, does it run code on install, how many downloads, and does its name imitate a popular package (typosquat). Verdict: ok_to_install, caution, dont_install or does_not_exist, with reasons. From OSV.dev, deps.dev, the npm registry and PyPI.

name.description: Package name, optionally with a version: "lodash", "lodash@4.17.15", "@scope/pkg", "requests==2.31.0".

name: package_check
title: Is this package safe to install?
